title: Samsung Launches World’s First HDR10+ ADVANCED Streaming Experience on Prime Video
content: Samsung Electronics today announced that Prime Video will be the first streaming service to offer HDR10+ ADVANCED on supported titles globally beginning August 2026, with the service being first available on Samsung’s 2026 TV lineup. title: Samsung Galaxy Z8 preorder sales hit record 1.44 million in South Korea
content: Samsung Electronics said its Galaxy Z8 foldable smartphone lineup generated 1.44 million preorders in South Korea, setting a new high for Galaxy phone preorder sales. The result marked the company’s strongest preorder performance in seven years and highlighted early demand for its latest foldables.

title: Samsung Foundry nears full utilization, but 2nm yields remain a hurdle
content: Samsung Electronics' contract chipmaking business could approach full utilization in the second half of 2026, marking a potential turning point after prolonged underuse weighed on earnings.

title: Analysis: Tesla's driverless ambitions get regulatory reality check
content: Tesla's latest quarterly results fell short of market expectations, but another development attracted equal attention: CEO Elon Musk adopted a noticeably more cautious tone when discussing the company's Robotaxi ambitions.

title: Onsemi details AI data center momentum, pricing strategy in Q2 earnings call
content: Onsemi's leadership fielded a wide range of investor questions following the company's second-quarter 2026 results, with much of the discussion centered on its accelerating AI data center business, capacity utilization, and how the company is managing rising input costs.

title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics reportedly fast-tracks Philippine MLCC plant in wake of AI-driven price hikes
content: Samsung Electro-Mechanics (SEMCO) is reportedly pulling forward the start-up of its first overseas multilayer ceramic capacitor (MLCC) plant, a move that underscores how an AI-driven scramble for the tiny components is reshaping pricing and investment across the industry.
